connector.name: Documentero
connector.registryDescription: List Documentero templates, inspect field schemas, and generate Word/PDF/Excel documents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the documentero account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DOCUMENTERO_API_KEY
env.description: Company API key from Documentero Account settings

env.name: DOCUMENTERO_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional Cloud API base URL (default: https://app.documentero.com/api)
